text:
Elena: Heads-up — after the runtime 2.16 roll last night a few customers hit SDK 3.x signature mismatches. Can someone clarify the official process for requesting a temporary pin/exemption with DeployBot?

DeployBot: @channel automated note: to request a pin, run `@DeployBot pin-request --service runtime --reason <brief>` and include a JIRA link. See /docs/pinning for policy. Pins with expiry must include rollback criteria.

Marco: Short answer: open a pin-request (PR to the pinlist repo) + post here with the PR link. For emergency short-lived pins you can add `expires: <ISO-date>` in the PR body.

Priya: Question: what counts as "emergency" vs "normal"? We had ~0.2% signature mismatches for customers on SDK 3.1, but no widespread user-impact. Do we still pin? :thinking_face:

Dan: If it's only 0.2% and we can backport an SDK shim within a day, prefer a canary rollback and targeted workaround instead of global pin. Pinning affects capacity routing and can cascade.

Elena: The shim patch timeline is ~6-8 hours for a small patch, but some teams want the pin now to avoid client errors this morning. Is DeployBot able to do region-scoped pins?

DeployBot: DeployBot tip: region-scoped pins supported. Use `@DeployBot pin-request --scope eu-west-1 --service runtime --expires 2025-02-10T18:00Z --reason "sdk-3.1-signature"`

Marco: If you request region-scoped pin, include telemetry evidence and a rollout plan. Ops will want thresholds for automatic unpin (e.g., error rate <0.05% for 2 hours).

Priya: Can we make the unpin conditional/automatic if the SDK shim deploy lands and health checks pass? Or do we require manual sign-off?

ops-bot: ops-bot reminder: automatic unpin hooks are only enabled for pinned PRs that include `unpin-on-deploy: true` and a matching deployment tag. Please coordinate with oncall.

Sara: For release notes / customer comms: if we pin at region level, we need to mark the change in the status page and add a short note in next release notes. Who owns that?

Raj: I can draft the status update. For release notes — add an item under "Runtime stability" saying: "Temporary routing pin applied to eu-west-1 to mitigate SDK 3.1 signature regressions; automated rollback planned after patch." Keep wording non-technical for external customers.

Elena: Appreciate that. One more: does pinning require an SDK version bump in the model routing table or just a runtime pin? Want to avoid double-change.

Marco: Runtime pin only for the serving runtime binary. If the SDK change requires different runtimes (ABI), we prefer runtime pin + targeted model-routing only if necessary. Avoid changing model routing unless compatibility proven.

Priya: OK — plan proposed: Elena to open pin-request PR scoped to eu-west-1 with `expires` set to 4h and `unpin-on-deploy: true`. Raj will draft status and Sara will post. Marco/ops will monitor thresholds. If shim patch lands and health <0.05% errors for 2h, DeployBot will auto-unpin.

Elena: Opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood/pinlist/pull/7823 (pin-request). Added JIRA: INF-4912 and telemetry screenshots.

DeployBot: Pin-request received: PR #7823. Pin scheduled for eu-west-1 at 2025-02-10T09:15Z. Auto-unpin hook enabled per PR metadata.

Dan: I'll take the patch roll and watch the canary for the next 2 hours. Ping me if the error rate jumps.

Priya: Thanks. Small nit: can we add a one-liner to the pin PR template reminding owners to update release-notes.md? Saved us last time.

Marco: Good call — filed infra task INF-4921 to add that reminder to the pin PR template.

Sara: Draft for status: "Applied temporary runtime routing pin in eu-west-1 to route affected SDK 3.1 traffic to a compatible runtime variant. Engineering has deployed a shim; automated rollback scheduled pending verification." I'll post once Raj approves. :thumbsup:

Raj: Approved. Posting in status shortly.

Elena: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical coordination log. Please reply if you see any unexpected routing behavior.

ops-bot: ops-bot note: oncall escalations during pin window go to @dan and @maria. If you'd like a manual unpin earlier than scheduled, run `@DeployBot unpin-request --pr 7823 --reason "early-unpin"` and tag oncall.

Dan: Got it — watching now.

Sara: Posted status update. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2025-02-10-sdk3-signature

Elena: Closing loop — will confirm unpin or rollback here when patch is validated. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
